bibl.title: A Terracotta Portrait-Head of Alexander the Great from Karanis.
bibl.seg: Sobhi Ashour & Ahmed Hassan, A Terracotta Portrait-Head of Alexander the Great from Karanis.
bibl.note: Kom Oushim Museum Magazine, Inv. No. 886. - Material, technique and mould. - Iconographic type. - Date [2nd century BC]. - Context and function [the head was found inside a shaft in the southern part of the Karanis necropolis].
